steps.en: Install the desktop app with your platform's package manager
steps.zh: 用系统的包管理器装上桌面应用

steps.en: Connect the accounts whose context you want it to know
steps.zh: 把你希望它了解上下文的数据源接进去

steps.en: One scheduler ticks every twenty minutes and syncs each connection
steps.zh: 一个调度器每二十分钟走一遍，逐个同步你接的连接

steps.en: Compresses what changed into scored Markdown trees + an Obsidian vault on your machine
steps.zh: 把新增内容压成 Markdown 记忆树并镜像成 Obsidian 库

steps.en: Ask a question about your own work
steps.zh: 问你自己的工作上的事

steps.en: Answers from memory it already built, and proposes automations you review on a canvas
steps.zh: 用已经建好的记忆作答，并把自动化提议成你能在画布上审的工作流

steps.en: Fires scheduled runs behind your approval gate, resuming after restarts
steps.zh: 在审批闸门后按计划触发运行，重启后接着跑

value.en: Your assistant starts day one with compressed context of your inbox, repos, docs and chats — instead of weeks of re-briefing a cold agent
value.zh: 助手第一天就带着你的邮件、仓库、文档与聊天上下文开工，不用花几周从冷启动教它

sources: https://github.com/tinyhumansai/openhuman README (OAuth integrations feeding the brain, auto-fetch every 20 minutes, Memory Tree + Obsidian wiki as scored Markdown in SQLite, workflows proposed by the agent and reviewed on a canvas, durable trigger-driven approval-gated runs)
INSTALL.md — macOS Homebrew Cask section (brew install --cask openhuman); .deb / AUR / MSI / AppImage paths
gitbooks/features/obsidian-wiki/auto-fetch.md (single 20-minute tick walks every active integration; per-connection sync_state: cursor, last sync, daily budget, dedup set)
gitbooks/features/channels.md (channel = two-way conversation surface, distinct from a read-only integration)
